titleEn: Bathroom Renovation Cost Langley BC 2026: Real Prices by Project Type
titleZh: 兰利浴室装修费用 2026：按项目类型的真实价格
contentEn:
Langley bathroom renovation costs in 2026 range from $12,000 for a basic refresh to $200,000 or more for a luxury spa build. A basic refresh — new paint, updated hardware, a replacement vanity, and a new toilet — keeps the existing layout and touches no plumbing or electrical. A full custom tile renovation with a curbless shower, heated floors, and premium fixtures can reach $60,000 or beyond. Every price below comes from Reno Stars projects completed in Langley and across Metro Vancouver.

How much does a basic bathroom refresh cost in Langley?

A basic bathroom refresh in Langley — new paint, updated cabinet hardware, a replacement vanity, a new toilet, and new light fixtures — costs $12,000–$20,000 in 2026. This scope keeps the existing layout and does not move any plumbing or electrical rough-ins. Work typically completes in one to two weeks. Homeowners can usually remain in the house throughout.

This price tier does not include moving drains, replacing the bathtub, or upgrading the electrical panel — those changes push the project into a higher cost category. A basic refresh is a surface update: it makes an older bathroom feel modern without the disruption and cost of a full reconfiguration.

What does a mid-range bathroom renovation cost in Langley?

A mid-range Langley bathroom renovation — new tile, a replacement vanity with a quartz countertop, a new toilet, updated lighting, and upgraded fixtures — costs $20,000–$35,000 in 2026. This scope covers the full bathroom while keeping the existing layout. A mid-range reno typically takes three to five weeks. This is the most common investment level for homeowners updating a single family home bathroom in Langley, Willoughby, or Brookswood.

What does a full custom tile bathroom renovation cost in Langley?

A full custom tile bathroom renovation in Langley — with a curbless tiled shower, heated floors, a new vanity and countertop, premium fixtures, and all new tile throughout — costs $35,000–$60,000 in 2026. This scope requires waterproofing to BC Code standards, often using Schluter-Kerdi or Wedi membrane systems, and may include moved drains or electrical circuits that require a permit. Timeline runs four to seven weeks.

Langley homes built before 1990 — particularly in Brookswood, Aldergrove, and the original Langley City neighbourhood — frequently require asbestos testing before demolition. This adds approximately $300–$800 to the project cost but is mandatory under BC regulations and must be completed before any demo work begins.

How much does a master bathroom ensuite cost in Langley?

A master bathroom ensuite renovation in Langley with a double vanity, a walk-in tiled shower with bench seating, a soaker tub, heated floors, and premium finishes costs $60,000–$100,000 in 2026. This scope covers a full gut of an existing bathroom including structural changes if needed. Premium finish selections — heated towel bars, smart toilets, designer tile, or custom millwork — push the project toward the upper end of this range. Timeline runs seven to ten weeks.

What does a luxury spa bathroom cost in Langley?

A luxury spa bathroom in Langley — steam shower, smart fixtures throughout, custom built-in millwork, designer tile, programmable ambient lighting, and integrated sound — costs $100,000–$200,000 or more in 2026. This scope is most common in whole-house renovation projects in Walnut Grove, Campbell Heights, or high-end properties in Fort Langley. Timeline runs ten to sixteen weeks. These projects typically involve an architect or design consultant in addition to Reno Stars' project management team.

What drives bathroom renovation costs up in Langley?

Four factors most commonly increase costs beyond the baseline estimate in Langley. First, layout changes — moving a toilet or shower across the room requires rerouting drain lines and vent stacks, adding $3,000–$8,000. Second, pre-1990 construction — Brookswood, Aldergrove, and older Langley City homes frequently have asbestos in the floor backing or pipe insulation, requiring a certified abatement company before demo can begin. Third, heated floor installation — electric mat under tile adds $1,500–$4,000 but is particularly popular in Langley given the property styles and climate. Fourth, premium fixture selection — a freestanding soaker tub runs $3,500–$8,000, and a steam shower system with generator and vapour-proof glass adds $8,000–$18,000.

Langley Bathroom Renovation Cost FAQ

How much does a bathroom renovation cost in Langley BC in 2026?

Basic bathroom refreshes in Langley start at $12,000–$20,000. Mid-range full bathroom renovations run $20,000–$35,000. Custom tile renovations with curbless showers and heated floors cost $35,000–$60,000. Master ensuites with premium fixtures range $60,000–$100,000. Luxury spa bathrooms start at $100,000. All prices are based on Reno Stars projects completed in Langley and Metro Vancouver in 2025–2026.

Do I need a permit for a bathroom renovation in Langley?

Langley (both City and Township) requires building permits for any work that moves plumbing drains or supply lines, adds new electrical circuits, or changes the structural configuration of the bathroom. Cosmetic work — painting, vanity replacement, new lighting — does not require a permit. Reno Stars handles all permit applications as part of the project scope for any work that crosses the permit threshold.

How long does a bathroom renovation take in Langley?

A basic bathroom refresh in Langley takes one to two weeks. A mid-range renovation with new tile and fixtures takes three to five weeks. A full custom tile bathroom with permit-required work takes four to seven weeks. A master ensuite with premium finishes and possible structural changes takes seven to ten weeks. Luxury spa bathrooms run ten to sixteen weeks.

What is included in a Reno Stars bathroom renovation quote?

Every Reno Stars bathroom quote includes an in-home assessment with measurements, a written scope of work, a fixed-price contract, waterproofing to BC Code §3.7 wet-room standards, a pre-tile pressure test on all plumbing rough-ins, BC building permit handling where required, $5 million commercial general liability insurance, WorkSafeBC coverage, and a three-year workmanship warranty. Final clean and a walkthrough with the homeowner are included on every project.

Planning a bathroom renovation in Langley, Walnut Grove, Willoughby, Brookswood, or anywhere in the Township of Langley? Get a free, no-obligation quote from Reno Stars.
contentZh:
2026 年兰利（Langley）浴室装修费用差异极大：从 $12,000 的基础翻新，到含蒸汽淋浴、智能设施和定制木制品的豪宅浴室可达 $200,000 或以上。基础翻新仅更新表面，保持现有布局，不涉及管道或电气改造。以下每条数据均来自聚星装修在兰利及大温地区实际完成的项目。

兰利基础浴室翻新费用是多少？

兰利基础浴室翻新——新油漆、更新五金件、更换浴室柜和新马桶——2026 年费用为 $12,000–$20,000。此范围保持现有布局，不移动任何管道或电气线路。工程通常在一至两周内完成。业主在施工期间通常可继续居住。

此价位不包含移动排水管、更换浴缸或升级配电箱——这些改动会将项目推向更高价位。基础翻新是表面更新：让旧浴室焕然一新，而无需付出全面翻新的成本和 disruption。

中档浴室改造费用是多少？

兰利中档浴室改造——新瓷砖、更换带石英石台面的浴室柜、新马桶、更新照明和升级五金件——2026 年费用为 $20,000–$35,000。此范围覆盖全浴室同时保留现有布局。中档改造通常需三至五周。这是兰利、Willoughby 或 Brookswood 独立屋单间浴室更新中最常见的投资水平。

全定制瓷砖浴室装修费用是多少？

兰利全定制瓷砖浴室装修——无门槛瓷砖淋浴间、加热地板、新浴室柜和台面、优质五金件、全屋新瓷砖——2026 年费用为 $35,000–$60,000。此范围需符合 BC 省标准的防水工程，通常使用 Schluter-Kerdi 或 Wedi 膜系统，并可能包括需许可证的排水或电路改造。工期四至七周。

1990 年前建造的兰利房屋——尤其是 Brookswood、Aldergrove 和兰利市原始社区——通常需要在拆除前进行石棉检测。这将增加约 $300–$800 的费用，但根据 BC 省规定是强制性的，必须在拆除工作开始前完成。

主人套房装修费用是多少？

带双台盆、步入式瓷砖淋浴间（含座椅）、浸泡浴缸、加热地板和优质饰面的兰利主人套房装修——2026 年费用为 $60,000–$100,000。此范围覆盖现有浴室的全面拆除，必要时包括结构改造。优质饰面选择——加热毛巾架、智能马桶、设计师瓷砖或定制木制品——将项目推向此范围的上限。工期七至十周。

豪华水疗浴室费用是多少？

兰利豪华水疗浴室——蒸汽淋浴、全屋智能设施、定制内置木制品、设计师瓷砖、可编程环境照明和集成音响——2026 年费用为 $100,000–$200,000 或以上。此范围最常见于 Walnut Grove、Campbell Heights 或 Fort Langley 高端房产的全屋装修项目。工期十至十六周。这些项目通常除聚星装修的项目管理外，还涉及建筑设计师或设计顾问。

哪些因素会增加兰利浴室装修费用？

四个因素最常见地使兰利浴室装修费用超出基准估算。第一，布局改变——将马桶或淋浴间跨房间移动需要重新布管排水和排气管线，增加 $3,000–$8,000。第二，1990 年前建筑——Brookswood、Aldergrove 和较老的兰利市房屋地板垫层或管道保温层常有石棉，需在拆除前聘请认证治理公司。第三，加热地板安装——瓷砖下的电热垫增加 $1,500–$4,000，但在兰利 given 房产风格和气候条件特别受欢迎。第四，优质五金件选择——独立式浸泡浴缸 $3,500–$8,000，带发生器和蒸汽防汽玻璃的蒸汽淋浴系统增加 $8,000–$18,000。

兰利浴室装修费用常见问题

2026 年 BC 省兰利浴室装修费用是多少？

兰利基础浴室翻新起价 $12,000–$20,000。中档全浴室装修 $20,000–$35,000。含无门槛淋浴间和加热地板的定制瓷砖装修 $35,000–$60,000。含优质五金件的主人套房 $60,000–$100,000。豪华水疗浴室起价 $100,000。所有价格均基于聚星装修 2025–2026 年在兰利和大温地区完成的项目。

兰利浴室装修需要许可证吗？

兰利（市和镇）要求对任何移动管道排水或供水管线、增加新电路或改变浴室结构配置的工作申请建筑许可证。 Cosmetic 工作——油漆、浴室柜更换、新照明——不需要许可证。聚星装修处理所有许可证申请，作为需要许可证的工作范围的一部分。

兰利浴室装修需要多长时间？

兰利基础浴室翻新需一至两周。含新瓷砖和五金的翻新需三至五周。含许可证要求工程的全定制瓷砖浴室需四至七周。含优质饰面和可能结构改造的主人套房需七至十周。豪华水疗浴室需十至十六周。

聚星装修浴室装修报价包含什么？

每份聚星装修浴室报价均包含上门评估（含测量）、书面工程范围、固定价格合同、符合 BC 省法规第 3.7 条湿室防水标准、铺砖前所有管道粗调的圧力测试、BC 省建筑许可证办理（如需要）、500 万加元商业综合责任保险、WorkSafeBC 保险覆盖，以及三年工艺质保。每个项目均包含最终清洁和业主 walkthrough。
